question: Do learned raw-byte motifs and adaptive granularity transfer into a sealed fourth synthetic domain by reusing shared low-level structures, requiring only bounded domain-specific state growth and preserving prior-domain capability?
hypothesis: After training one bounded motif store on three disjoint synthetic domains, the held-out fourth domain will achieve at least 0.65 zero-shot target accuracy from four shared motifs, reach at least 0.95 after adapting only two new domain-specific motifs, require at most two added motif entries versus at least six for a fresh target-domain learner, preserve source-domain accuracy within 0.01, and retain at least 0.18 adaptive event reduction on the held-out domain.

prior_evidence.scientific_claim: Learned motifs enabled uncertainty-selective granularity with perfect target accuracy, 20% total event reduction, and zero false coarse activation in high-entropy regions.

authority: research-only; no production, live, accepted-ref, scheduler, queue-consumer, external-model inference, or cross-lane authority changes

domains.shared_motifs: WBG-2 motifs 0..3 with unchanged successor mapping
domains.corpus_record: four-byte motif + successor + three domain-specific filler bytes
domains.boundary_visibility: domain ID and record boundaries are available to corpus construction/evaluation only; motif learner sees concatenated raw bytes

learner.selection: same recurrence/consistency rule as WBG-2, but entries are admitted into one persistent global motif store until capacity 12
learner.prediction: exact learned motif match -> learned successor; otherwise byte-level fallback zero
learner.adaptation: target-domain adaptation may add new entries but may not rewrite or evict existing entries

corpora.seed_policy: All four seeds were checked against the Wingless repository before preregistration and had no matches.
corpora.schedule: balanced motif schedule within each domain; every six-record block contains all four shared and both domain-specific motifs exactly once

evaluation.zero_shot: Evaluate held-out domain before any target adaptation.
evaluation.adapted: Adapt persistent learner on held-out adaptation stream, then evaluate held-out domain again.
evaluation.fresh_control: Train an empty bounded store on the same held-out adaptation stream and evaluate the same target set.
evaluation.source_retention: Re-evaluate all three source domains after held-out adaptation.
evaluation.event_reduction: On held-out evaluation, exact learned motif spans count as one event instead of four; all other bytes count individually.

validity_criteria: Exact parent SHA, North Star identity, and supported WBG-3 evidence match.
All four seeds and all four domains complete frozen corpus cardinalities.
Held-out domain ID, motif identities, and boundary labels are unavailable to the learner.
The four shared motifs are byte-identical and successor-identical across all domains.
Each domain has exactly two unique motifs unavailable in the other three domains.
Persistent target adaptation may only add entries into the preallocated 12-slot store; no eviction, rewrite, capacity growth, or source retraining occurs.
Fresh control receives exactly the same held-out adaptation bytes as transfer learner.
Source retention is measured after target adaptation without source rehearsal.
Event reduction is computed only from exact learned motif spans.
The normalized result carries schema wingless.research-scientific-result.v1 and exact experiment identifier.
Full Go regression passes before probe execution.

classification_rules.supported: All eighteen frozen thresholds and all validity criteria pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Shared transfer and bounded target adaptation are demonstrated, but at least one state-growth, retention, or event-reduction threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but shared motifs do not transfer materially, target adaptation requires near-fresh state growth, or source capability degrades.
classification_rules.incomplete: Environmental or compute interruption prevents frozen cardinality.
classification_rules.invalid: Provenance, domain isolation, store-capacity, no-rewrite/no-eviction, deterministic construction, or qualification isolation fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: After any output is observed, do not alter seeds, domains, motif definitions, successor rules, corpus sizes, store capacity, admission thresholds, adaptation policy, controls, metrics, thresholds, aggregation, or classification.
